capabilities.problem: A topic-core nomination may have only a plausible label without a version-bound source, exact passage, decision impact, and substitute reasoning.
capabilities.mechanism: Validate a production core nomination against actual source bytes and keep topic-core, classic, and closest-work judgments distinct.

hard_measures: every accepted core nomination binds a source version and exact passage
metric_effects.human_judgment: Independent rubric-evidence judges decide whether the contribution and decision effect actually justify core status.

guardrails: schema validity is not scientific endorsement
no popularity or publication-age shortcut
no private answer list

capabilities.problem: A per-topic gold paper list and manual source annotations block routine cross-topic Stage 1 assessment.
capabilities.mechanism: Freeze topic needs and rubric v3, collect bounded public-source evidence, extract all answer chunks separately for works and central claims, select source-bound spans with independent tool-free judges, and replay only validated v3.1 units with identical inputs and runtime. Recheck public-source bytes through the bound, documented source validate CLI and append raw validation observations instead of importing private research-hub Python helpers. Reconstruct a separate complete source audit view from replay-validated catalogue records, preserving full abstracts, distinct identity metadata, versions, raw-source hashes and explicit cutoff exclusions without changing historical packets. Complete routing assigns every phase span. The separate P3 execution path submits all units independently for R1/R2, retains per-span dispositions and original locations, and aggregates bounded pairs with preserved child bindings and contrary evidence; semantic disagreement triggers ADJ. Full evaluator integration remains pending.

hard_measures: subject claims, source levels, exact passages, unknowns, and raw acquisition receipts are separate
metric_effects.human_judgment: Independent rubric-evidence judges assess source support; automated agreement alone is not expert truth.

hard_measures: topic requirements are frozen independently; bounded challenge failures remain visible
metric_effects.human_judgment: Judges assess role, core and closest-work adequacy without expected titles or recall denominators.

hard_measures: actual subject traces remain distinct from evaluator searches and backend failures from empty results
metric_effects.human_judgment: Judges assess whether the subject's actual process can be reconstructed regardless of ledger format.

guardrails: no gold or human annotation is required for routine scoring
packet-only cannot prove coverage
evaluator errors are not subject zero
v3 cannot claim improvement before a paired experiment
subject and evaluator dependencies are separately bound
native evidence is admissible without treatment-specific ledger format
truncated judge views are disclosed and do not automatically lower subject scores
one semantic correction and at most one same-setting transient transport retry; failed attempts are retained
search-only and excluded-candidate mentions do not become bibliography entries; exact title-only repetitions resolve only to a unique explicit identity
criterion judges receive score prerequisites from their assigned work assessments; no automatic score repair
a real PDF text probe and bound parser versions/bytes gate evaluation before model calls; missing parser is an evaluator error
judge passage choices use per-unit schema-enumerated aliases with immutable canonical span bindings; no fuzzy ID or quote repair

offline source validation observations preserve exact stdout, stderr, exit and input hashes; failed or incomplete replay is not automatically repeated and source validation is not semantic claim endorsement
complete source representation is not completed model reading or semantic auditing; rehashed representations must reconstruct exactly from the original packet and full source catalogue

original citation values are restored from provenance-bound subject spans before source audits; conflicting occurrences remain separate, missing publication versions are not filled from external metadata, and original claims are unchanged

callable source audit units retain every work field and central claim, use all eligible located source windows with capped initial/correction prompts, preserve contrary leaves and missing originals, and never award rubric scores; formal pipeline integration and semantic aggregation remain pending
coverage routing is a pending prerequisite, not proof of completed semantic reading; preserve raw native arguments and status alongside decoded output; historical judging remains unchanged

P3 complete execution requires every planned native unit and aggregation edge; output and initial/correction prompts are byte bounded; a frozen whole-run unit/generation/attempt budget rejects before the first model call rather than truncating evidence; stable conclusion and missing-evidence codes participate in disagreement detection; missing units or inherited contrary evidence fail closed; independent requests are not shared judge generations; major-error and formal gates remain separate

capabilities.problem: A broad direction can silently become a country-specific search without a recorded user decision.
capabilities.mechanism: Record versioned user scope decisions and bind query families to confirmed needs, preserving suggestions, unrestricted choices and history.

hard_measures: unauthorized declared scope narrowing; decision provenance numerator and denominator; required clarification complete
metric_effects.human_judgment: Inspect actual query semantics and user source records; intake validity does not imply literature adequacy.

guardrails: pending material scope blocks compilation
suggestions are not user decisions
old plans cannot pass a new brief revision
no country default or frozen paper list

capabilities.problem: A literature run can finish with evaluator artifacts but no editable report, bibliography, classified metadata or lawful source package for the researcher.
capabilities.mechanism: Reserve a versioned Stage 1 exporter boundary that will derive researcher-facing views and a private source package from validated records, while publishing only hash-bound safe evidence.

hard_measures: source, decision and version links remain reconstructable; package-conformance counts are reported separately and never change P1-P3 scores
metric_effects.human_judgment: Judges assess the underlying research record, not the presence or polish of exported files.

guardrails: foundation status does not claim that the exporter exists
lawful public sources only and no access-control bypass
abstracts and metadata never become full text
downloaded papers stay outside Git
Japan pilot package conformance is not scientific-quality improvement

capability_extensions.mechanism: Freeze public v3 hashes, verify native captures and paired results, and expose all saved attempt snapshots through a separate read-only adapter. Preserve complete UTF-8 file versions, deleted-file history and literal native-field availability; unavailable timing, backend and unsaved history remain unknown.

hard_measures: six native A/B captures, source-bound v3 results, and atomic scores are verified before P1 non-regression is decided
metric_effects.human_judgment: The core team reviews a scientific improvement claim after the blinded rubric-evidence judgments.

hard_measures: three paired P2 deltas are recomputed from the ten frozen atomic criteria without a paper answer list
metric_effects.human_judgment: The core team reviews whether bounded source evidence supports any external coverage claim.

hard_measures: clean profiles and immutable capture bytes distinguish actual subject process evidence from evaluator-generated evidence
metric_effects.human_judgment: The core team reviews reconstruction and added major-error gates before publication.

hard_measures: the Stage 1 skill invokes a source-version-bound topic-core assessment
confirmed scope and family-to-need mappings are required before new searches; intake metrics remain separate from P1-P3 scores
metric_effects.human_judgment: Independent v3 judges assess whether the cited work actually changes the research decision.

hard_measures: native action IDs and queries are captured without forcing duplicate research-hub searches; missing source content and backend state stay unknown
metric_effects.human_judgment: Judge the actual evidence and stopping rationale under the same rubric, not a preferred record format.
